join: rows join to microstructure_subentries.csv on (dict, L)
caveats: Preverb subentries are the <div n='p'> dash convention (PWG/PW/WIL). MW = 0 BY DESIGN: it promotes preverb-verbs to separate headwords (macro/micro trade-off), so absence here is not structurelessness. Preverb = the first SLP1 {#..#} token after the em-dash; compound/rare preverbs (vyapa, aBy-A, upA) captured verbatim. Indigenous + name/plant dicts do not use this div.
